description:
Single-winner between child terminal commit and inbound child mail. Do not double-complete. Not a wait state machine.

## Background

If mail is already accepted as child followUp, that continuation must go idle before **one** settled packet. If terminal is already committed, later mail is recipient-terminal.

Same latch for **failed**, **aborted/halt**, and **parent session_shutdown**, not only happy-path settle.

## Races (all required)

- mail then settle → one settled after continuation idles; mail delivered
- settle commit then mail → recipient-terminal; one terminal event
- failed vs mail (both orders)
- shutdown vs mail (both orders)
- halt vs mail

## Success criteria

- Exactly one terminal event per run.
- No settled/failed/aborted packet plus a still-running prompt.

## Test plan

- Each race above.
- Logging: winner (settle | fail | abort | shutdown | mail-then-settle), terminal event count = 1.

## Considerations

Hook the runner’s terminal commit latch from 1.5. Keep it small.
title: Serialize child settlement against inbound mail with one terminal winner
